tr_h_list: When a new requirement sentence is input, the system shall extract relevant information.
When a malformed requirement sentence is input, the system shall report an error.
When a non-requirement sentence is input, the system shall not extract any information.
When the system is initialized, it shall contain design, functionality, and other necessary information.
When the system is initialized with incomplete data, it shall report an error.
When the system is initialized with invalid data, it shall not function correctly.
When Local Bundle Delivery is selected, the system shall support it as part of its functionality.
When an unsupported delivery method is selected, the system shall report an error.
When an invalid delivery method is selected, the system shall not function correctly.
When test data generation is requested, the system shall generate test data for BPv6, BPv7, LTP, and TCPCL protocols.
When an unsupported protocol is selected for test data generation, the system shall report an error.
When an invalid protocol is selected for test data generation, the system shall not function correctly.
When protocol interoperability is enabled, the system shall ensure seamless communication between different systems.
When protocol interoperability is disabled, the system shall not ensure seamless communication between different systems.
When an invalid protocol is selected for interoperability, the system shall not function correctly.
When verification features are enabled, the system shall provide features that make it easier to verify an implementation against the requirements.
When verification features are disabled, the system shall not provide features that make it easier to verify an implementation against the requirements.
When an invalid feature is selected for verification, the system shall not function correctly.
When procurement is initiated, the system shall provide a set of requirements for software procurement.
When an invalid procurement method is selected, the system shall report an error.
When an invalid requirement is selected for procurement, the system shall not function correctly.
When a requirement is written, the system shall contain only one specific and singular statement within 95% of all requirements.
When an RFC is generated, the system shall use consistent language within 99% of all RFCs.
When software is classified, the system shall associate a level of compliance and rigor within 100% of all classifications.
When software class is set to safety-critical, the system shall enforce strict compliance with runtime constraints.
The system shall log all runtime constraint violations within 1 second.
When a developer requests candidate requirements, the HDTN API shall provide information about software high level architecture.
When a maintainer requests implementation verification, the HDTN API shall provide software high level architecture information.
When CCSDS requests test data generation, the BPGen shall generate BPv6, BPv7, LTP, and TCPCL test data.
When PICS requests technology transfer facilitation, the HDTN API shall provide information about software high level architecture.
When a user interacts with the HDTN GUI, the HDTN GUI shall support NASA programs in accomplishing planned goals.
When BPSec requests software acquisition requirements, the HDTN API shall provide a set of requirements for software acquisition.
The HDTN API shall provide information about software high level architecture within 5 seconds.
The BPGen shall generate BPv6, BPv7, LTP, and TCPCL test data within 10 seconds.
The HDTN GUI shall support NASA programs in accomplishing planned goals within 10 seconds.
The HDTN API shall provide a set of requirements for software acquisition within 5 seconds.
When multiple requests are made to the HDTN API, the HDTN API shall handle each request concurrently.
When an error occurs in the HDTN GUI, the HDTN GUI shall display an error message.
When a software developer requests system information, the system shall provide a detailed design document within 1 minute.
The system shall provide a verification report within 2 hours of implementation completion.
When a technology transfer request is made, the system shall facilitate HDTN project data exchange within 3 days.
When an error occurs, the system shall display an error message with a unique identifier within 5 seconds.
